policy_effect.scope: Acknowledgement timing only, at a fixed eight-publication window and 64 retained permits; not an estimate for Jai-sized queues.

host_monitor.policy: 60 seconds without active compilers, three quiet five-second samples below 0.3 core per process; interrupt own runner on any active compiler or the same unrelated PID above 0.8 core twice. Idle MSBuild allowed below 0.01 core.

observations: Jai normally acknowledges after enqueueing, not final socket drain; request wrapper calls relieve only for noted behind connections.
Default per-connection queue soft threshold 4096 frames, hard limit 65536 frames; socket loop coalesces up to64 frames per write.
Goose preserves per-post final drain and fixed eight-publication global window; complete fan-out rates count all64 readers for both, but permitted overlap differs.
Source review does not quantify the effect of acknowledgement policy on the measured gap.

reference_check.result: Both remote main revisions unchanged before and after measurement

reproduction.Dockerfile.ack-policy-runtime:
FROM once-campfire-goose:queued-ack-test AS build
FROM ubuntu:24.04 AS runtime
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates liburing2 libcrypt1 libstdc++6 libqrencode4 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && mkdir -p /rails/storage/db /rails/storage/files /rails/storage/logs \
    && chown -R 1000:1000 /rails
WORKDIR /rails
COPY --from=build /src/build/campfire /usr/local/bin/campfire
COPY assets/reference assets/reference
COPY data data
COPY LICENSE /usr/share/doc/once-campfire-goose/LICENSE
COPY views/MIT-LICENSE /usr/share/doc/once-campfire-goose/MIT-LICENSE
USER 1000:1000
ENV HTTP_PORT=3000 DATABASE_PATH=/rails/storage/db/production.sqlite3 STORAGE_PATH=/rails/storage/files
EXPOSE 3000
ARG GIT_REVISION=unknown
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source="https://github.com/aardappel/once-campfire-goose" \
      org.opencontainers.image.revision="${GIT_REVISION}" \
      org.opencontainers.image.licenses="Apache-2.0 AND MIT"
CMD ["/usr/local/bin/campfire"]

parser.add_argument('--prefix', required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
build = root / 'build'

def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

report = dict(runs={}, samples={}, medians={}, validation={}, excluded_attempts={})
identities = set()
for suffix, expected, policy in [('baseline-before', 2, 'drained'), ('comparison', 9, 'queued'), ('baseline-after', 2, 'drained')]:
    directory = build / f'{args.prefix}-{suffix}'
    metadata = read(directory / 'metadata.json')
    assert metadata['complete'] and not metadata['goose_dirty'] and not metadata['verification_dirty']
    assert metadata['goose_publication_ack'] == policy and metadata['goose_backend'] == 'epoll'
    identities.add((metadata['executable_sha256'], metadata['images']['goose']['id'], metadata['goose_revision'], metadata['loadgen_sha256'], metadata['seed_sha256']))
    rows = [read(p) for p in sorted(directory.glob('*-baseline-*.json'))]
    assert len(rows) == expected, (directory, len(rows))
    report['runs'][directory.name] = dict(metadata=metadata, rows=rows)
    for row in rows:
        group = f'goose_{policy}' if row['app'] == 'goose' else row['app']
        if row['app'] == 'goose':
            assert f'Publication acknowledgement: {policy}' in row['backend_log']
        assert row['post_write_audit']['verified']
        target = report['samples'].setdefault(group, {})
        for sample in row['samples']:
            assert sample['errors'] == sample['invalid_responses'] == 0
            target.setdefault(sample['route'], []).append(dict(
                rps=sample['rps'], memory_mib=sample['server_anonymous_bytes_after']/1048576,
                cpu_cores=sample['server_cpu_cores'], generator_cores=sample['generator_cpu_percent']/100))
        fanout = row['fanout']
        throughput = fanout['throughput']
        assert fanout['ready'] == fanout['clients'] == 64 and fanout['failed'] == 0
        assert throughput['post_errors'] == 0 and throughput['complete'] == throughput['posted']
        assert fanout['latency']['post_errors'] == 0 and fanout['latency']['complete'] == 20
        assert fanout['persisted_messages'] == throughput['complete'] + 20
        target.setdefault('fanout', []).append(dict(
            rps=throughput['delivered_msgs_per_sec'],
            memory_mib=fanout['phase_metrics']['saturated_drained']['anonymous_bytes']/1048576,
            p99_ms=throughput['all_clients']['p99_ms'], post_p99_ms=throughput['post']['p99_ms'],
            drain_seconds=throughput['drain_secs'],
            cpu_us=1e6*(fanout['phase_metrics']['saturated_drained']['cpu_seconds']-
                        fanout['phase_metrics']['saturated']['cpu_seconds'])/throughput['complete']))
assert len(identities) == 1, 'Policy comparison must use identical Goose image, executable, source, seed and load generator'
for group, routes in report['samples'].items():
    report['medians'][group] = {}
    for route, samples in routes.items():
        result = {k: statistics.median(s[k] for s in samples) for k in samples[0]}
        result['rate_range'] = [min(s['rps'] for s in samples), max(s['rps'] for s in samples)]
        report['medians'][group][route] = result
drained = report['medians']['goose_drained']['fanout']['rps']
queued = report['medians']['goose_queued']['fanout']['rps']
jai = report['medians']['jai']['fanout']['rps']
report['policy_effect'] = dict(queued_gain_percent=100*(queued/drained-1),
    original_absolute_gap_msgs_s=jai-drained, remaining_absolute_gap_msgs_s=jai-queued,
    fraction_of_absolute_gap_closed=(queued-drained)/(jai-drained),
    jai_over_drained=jai/drained, jai_over_queued=jai/queued,
    scope='Acknowledgement timing only, at a fixed eight-publication window and 64 retained permits; not an estimate for Jai-sized queues.')

monitor_path = build / f'{args.prefix}-host-monitor.jsonl'
monitor = [json.loads(line) for line in monitor_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines()]
assert not any(m['phase'] == 'interruption' for m in monitor)
measured = [m for m in monitor if m['phase'] == 'measurement']
assert measured and all(m['compilers'] == 0 for m in measured)
last_heavy = set()
activity = {}
for entry in measured:
    heavy = {p['id'] for p in entry['active'] if p['cores'] > .8}
    assert not heavy & last_heavy, 'Sustained unrelated CPU activity'
    last_heavy = heavy
    for process in entry['active']:
        activity.setdefault(process['name'], []).append(process['cores'])
report['host_monitor'] = dict(samples=monitor, measurement_samples=len(measured),
    background={k: dict(observations=len(v), max_cores=max(v)) for k, v in activity.items()},
    policy='60 seconds without active compilers, three quiet five-second samples below 0.3 core per process; interrupt own runner on any active compiler or the same unrelated PID above 0.8 core twice. Idle MSBuild allowed below 0.01 core.')
for path in sorted(build.glob('ack-policy-quiet*-host-monitor.jsonl')):
    prefix = path.name.removesuffix('-host-monitor.jsonl')
    if prefix == args.prefix:
        continue
    report['excluded_attempts'][prefix] = dict(
        monitor=[json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines()],
        runs={directory.name: dict(metadata=read(directory / 'metadata.json'), rows=[read(p) for p in sorted(directory.glob('*-baseline-*.json'))])
              for directory in sorted(build.glob(f'{prefix}-*')) if directory.is_dir() and (directory / 'metadata.json').exists()})
for name in ['queued-ack-full-test', 'ack-policy-native', 'ack-policy-parity', 'ack-policy-package', 'queued-ack-package']:
    report['validation'][name] = (build / f'{name}.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
assert report['validation']['queued-ack-full-test'].count('queued acknowledgements') == 6
assert report['validation']['ack-policy-native'].count('queued acknowledgements') == 2
report['validation']['browser'] = read(build / 'ack-policy-browser/receipt.json')
assert report['validation']['browser']['passed']
report['validation']['rendering'] = {ref: read(build / f'ack-policy-render-{ref}/result.json') for ref in ['rust', 'jai']}
for cases in report['validation']['rendering'].values():
    assert len(cases) == 27 and all(cases.values())
report['dependencies'] = read(root / 'dependencies.json')
report['reference_delivery_review'] = read(build / 'jai-delivery-review/review.json')
report['reference_check'] = read(build / 'ack-policy-reference-check.json')
report['packaging_checksums'] = (build / 'ack-policy-checksums.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
report['reproduction'] = {name: (build / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig') for name in [
    f'measure-{args.prefix}.sh', f'monitor-{args.prefix}.ps1', 'Dockerfile.ack-policy-runtime',
    'Dockerfile.queued-ack', 'validate-ack-policy-native.sh', 'validate-ack-policy-parity.sh', 'summarize-ack-policy.py']}
print(json.dumps(dict(medians=report['medians'], effect=report['policy_effect'],
    host={k:v for k,v in report['host_monitor'].items() if k != 'samples'}), indent=2))
(root / 'docs/queued-acknowledgements-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
